mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/license.md <<'EOF'
# Source license

The project's current recorded decision is to license the source under Apache-2.0, chosen because it gives more freedom to reuse the code in other projects.
EOF
cat docs/policies/license.md

Muninn also still lists an older GPL-3.0 record (#11) as active and flags a conflict with #28. #11 is a lower-trust transcript excerpt from before #28, so I treated #28 as the current one. I left GPL-3.0 out of the file. If you want to confirm which record stands, it's worth a quick check.
